capabilities: modify contents of files without opening them
extras: README mainly points to external documentation and links (removed here); the author requests community contributions via the Issues database and mentions related products JournalCraft and Cornell Notes Learning Vault.
problem: Obsidian's built-in text commands work on the visible file, so editing text in unopened files and quickly selecting lines or blocks is awkward.
summary: Swiss-army text toolkit that modifies file contents even when the file is not visible and adds quick selection and block-reference commands.
